scope: All nine observed tenant gallery templates; all 17 official AI fulfillment native files; all 33 current v3.5 digital-channel repository archives; all entries in the cached CCE/WXCC template tables; captured AI/email/SMS public tutorials. Priority tags do not exclude other channels within these collections. This is bounded corpus coverage, not every Cisco sample globally.
count_unit: Inventory entries by evidence cohort, not deduplicated unique flows; tutorials, legacy generations and equivalent source occurrences remain separate.

status_semantics.documented_topology: Source states the major connected execution path; not an exact native edge extraction.
status_semantics.documented_partial_contract: Source explains useful dependencies or branches, but does not establish every native node/edge.
status_semantics.observed_static_canvas: Sanitized configured sample graph was captured; no flow execution was performed.
status_semantics.derived_summary_available: A separate summary JSON matches the current capture SHA256; this is not an independent QA or runtime claim.
status_semantics.authored_from_current_capture: The summary index records an authored walkthrough for the same current capture hash.

source_exclusions.reason: Message-content templates, not executable flow samples
Sandbox messaging/API exercise without its own connected sample flow
Studio access guide, not a sample flow
Historical releases are version duplicates; current v3.5 collection is inventoried in full, with the older help listing retained for version-conflict context
Individual-node illustration, covered by node reference rather than a standalone AI/email/SMS sample
Call Workflow mechanism illustration, covered by node/lifecycle references
